_meta.purpose: Cifra multi-instrumento de Waiting for Stevie (Pearl Jam, Dark Matter 2024). Estrutura: instruments contem diagramas de acordes por instrumento (violao 6 cordas Drop D, ukulele 4 cordas, piano notas); content eh o texto ChordPro compartilhado entre os 3.
_meta.note_afinacao: Violao em Drop D (DADGBE) — corda 6 afinada em D.

title: Waiting for Stevie
content:
{section: Intro}
[D] [Am] [F] [G] (x2)
[D]

{section: Refrão 1}
             [D]              [Am]
You can be loved by everyone
             [F] [G]            [D]
And not feel,  not feel love
                           [Am]
You can be told by everyone
            [F]  [G]              [D]
And not hear a word from above

{section: Verso 1}
[A#]                                                     [D]
  Swallowed up by the sound cutting holes in the clouds
[A#]                                               [D]     [Cadd9]
  Finds herself in the song, hears her own voice rising

{section: Refrão 2}
             [D]              [Am]

                                  [Am]
Would have to take an act of faith
              [F]    [G]               [D]

{section: Verso 2}
[A#]                                                  [D]
  Words follow her down, needs to shake 'em off now, now
[A#]                                        [D]     [Cadd9]

[Bm]             [D7]
  Callin' on a messenger
[G]              [Em]
 Awaitin' on a face
[Bm]                        [D7]

For her love, her love
